timingPolicy: Keep every source cue outer bound; split only at the next retained Japanese fragment timestamp; make children exactly adjacent.
textPolicy: Collapse whitespace only; preserve every English word and its strict order.
fallbackPolicy: Replace a source cue only when a complete all-budget partition exists; otherwise keep it valid and audit every unresolved violation.
developmentGate: Measurable readable-cue gain with exact text, timing, gap and speaker integrity and no metric regression.
